title: the four row lock strengths: T1 holds one on each row, T2 asks for every strength with NOWAIT

steps.sql: BEGIN

steps.note: T1 locks row 1 FOR KEY SHARE, row 2 FOR SHARE, row 3 FOR NO KEY UPDATE and row 4 FOR UPDATE.

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 1 FOR KEY SHARE NOWAIT
steps.note: row 1 is held FOR KEY SHARE. T2 asks FOR KEY SHARE.

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 1 FOR SHARE NOWAIT
SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 1 FOR NO KEY UPDATE NOWAIT
SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
steps.note: row 1, FOR UPDATE: the one strength KEY SHARE blocks.

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 2 FOR KEY SHARE NOWAIT
steps.note: row 2 is held FOR SHARE. T2 asks FOR KEY SHARE.

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 2 FOR SHARE NOWAIT
SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 2 FOR NO KEY UPDATE NOWAIT

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 2 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 3 FOR KEY SHARE NOWAIT
steps.note: row 3 is held FOR NO KEY UPDATE. T2 asks FOR KEY SHARE.

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 3 FOR SHARE NOWAIT

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 3 FOR NO KEY UPDATE NOWAIT

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 3 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 4 FOR KEY SHARE NOWAIT
steps.note: row 4 is held FOR UPDATE. T2 asks FOR KEY SHARE.

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 4 FOR SHARE NOWAIT

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 4 FOR NO KEY UPDATE NOWAIT

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id = 4 FOR UPDATE NOWAIT

error.message: could not obtain lock on row in relation "t"

steps.sql: UPDATE t SET note = 'changed' WHERE id = 1
steps.note: a plain UPDATE of a non-key column on row 1 goes straight through T1's FOR KEY SHARE.

steps.sql: UPDATE t SET note = 'changed' WHERE id = 2
steps.note: the same UPDATE on row 2 waits for T1's FOR SHARE: a plain UPDATE takes FOR NO KEY UPDATE.

steps.sql: COMMIT
steps.note: T1 ends its transaction, and T2's update of row 2 goes through.
